description: Routing eval for the Vercel MCP server alone (151 read-only tools enabled, run with every other server disabled). Cases are tagged by phrasing: `direct` reuses the tool descriptions' vocabulary, `indirect` is how a user would say it, `confusable` has near-duplicate tools. `expected` tools must all be returned, `any_of` needs at least one, `acceptable` tools are fine extras. Any other returned tool is noise.
